tools.name: market_status
tools.description:
Is the Tehran market open right now, and when does it open next? Tehran time, today's status (open, before_open, after_close, weekend or holiday),

    Holidays come from the official calendar of 1405; days the exchange closes without notice are flagged in calendar_check when its own data disagrees.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Stock screener (فیلتر نویسی): the filter box of tsetmc.com driven by an expression. Returns only the stocks that pass your condition right now, using today's live values plus up to 60 past trading days (close[1], avg(volume, 20), count(close_pct > 0, 3)) and real/legal money flow, in one call with a validated, safe expression (nothing is executed).
tools.fa: اسکرینر و فیلتر نویس: شرط بنویس، نمادهای رد شده را بگیر

params.name: filter
params.description: Condition checked for every stock, e.g. "volume > 2 * avg(volume, 20) and close_pct > 1". Today: last close open high low yesterday last_pct close_pct volume value(rial) trades pe eps market_cap bid_volume ask_volume at_upper_limit buy_queue real_net_value real_buyer_power industry symbol. Past days: close[1] (yesterday), avg(volume, 20), highest(high, 10), count(close_pct > 0, 5), all(close_pct < 0, 3). Operators: and or not, has(industry, 'بانک'), 5B = 5 billion rial. All fields and functions: screener_reference.

params.name: preset
params.description: Ready-made filter, e.g. volume_surge, smart_money, breakout_20d, buy_queue (screener_reference lists them). ANDed with filter.

params.name: industry
params.description: Industry name substring, e.g. 'بانک'

params.name: columns
params.description: Expressions to show, optionally 'expr as label'. Default: symbol, last, close_pct, volume, value plus the fields and window values the filter uses.

params.name: sort
params.description: Expression to sort by, e.g. 'volume / avg(volume, 20)'. Default: the preset's, else value.

tools.name: index_history
tools.description: History of any index (تاریخچه شاخص) in index points, not rial: the total index (شاخص کل) back to 2008, equal-weight, free-float, any industry index such as فلزات or بانک, and the Fara Bourse indices. Rows ascending with close, low, high and daily change %, plus a summary of the whole requested range: change %, highest and lowest close with dates, maximum drawdown, up/down days and a volatility estimate. Days the market was closed are flagged flat and kept out of the statistics. With intraday=true: today's 5-minute path with day high/low and the previous close.
tools.fa: تاریخچه و روند لحظه‌ای هر شاخص

params.name: index
params.description: Index name or fragment: 'شاخص کل', 'شاخص کل (هم وزن)', 'شاخص آزاد شناور', 'فلزات', 'بانک', 'شاخص کل فرابورس' (English: total, equal_weight, fara), an industry code such as 27, or an insCode from the indices tool. A fragment that matches several indices is an error that lists them.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Range bound: Gregorian 2026-11-03 / 20261103 or Jalali 1405/08/12. Omit for no bound.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Range bound: Gregorian 2026-11-03 / 20261103 or Jalali 1405/08/12. Omit for no bound.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most rows to return (default 120). Longer ranges are thinned by granularity, or cut to the newest rows (max 500)

params.name: granularity
params.description: 'auto' (default: daily rows if the range fits limit, else weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly closes), 'daily', 'weekly' (Saturday-start), 'monthly', 'quarterly' or 'yearly' (Jalali)

tools.name: index_constituents
tools.description: Member stocks of an index (سهام شاخص) with close, change %, volume, value and each stock's effect in index points on the total index (تاثیر در شاخص, from the exchange), plus totals: members, advancers/decliners, traded value, sum of effects. The exchange publishes no index weights, so market-cap share is only a derived proxy (sort_by market_cap). Effects are for the latest session and are left out, with a note, when the exchange's table does not add up to the index move; for a sector index they are the effect on the total index, not on the sector index.
tools.fa: اعضای شاخص و تأثیر هر نماد

tools.name: fund_ranking
tools.description: Ranking and screening of the investment-fund registry (صندوق‌های سرمایه‌گذاری): about 580 funds of 15 types, not only the exchange-traded ones, with net assets, units, redemption/issue/statistical NAV (ابطال، صدور، آماری), returns over 1 day to 1 year and since inception, portfolio mix (stock/bond/deposit), manager and NAV date. Sort by any return or size, filter by type and minimum net assets. Returns are percent as published, null where the fund is too young. The registry has no ticker: find the traded unit with search_symbol on the fund's name, then etf_nav for its NAV premium. Market-maker and very young funds show extreme returns, so filter them for a fair ranking.

params.description: Fund type: fixed_income (درآمد ثابت), equity (سهام: every stock fund), equity_general (در سهام), mixed (مختلط), gold (طلا و کالا), market_maker (بازارگردانی), sector, leveraged, index, venture, private, project, fund_of_funds, real_estate, principal_protected, pension; a Persian name or fragment, a numeric type id, or a comma-separated list. Omit for every type.

tools.name: option_chain
tools.description: Option chain (اختیار معامله) of the Tehran derivatives market: for an underlying ('اهرم', 'شستا', 'وبملت' ...) and expiry, every strike with its call (خرید) and put (فروش) leg - last/close price, bid/ask, volume, value, open interest, change % - plus derived (computed, not published) moneyness ITM/OTM, intrinsic and time value, break-even, bid-ask spread, put/call ratios, top open-interest strikes and an estimated max pain. Omit underlying to list the underlyings that have options. Prices are rial per underlying unit, one contract = contract_size units; legs with no trade today show no price; open interest is the clearing house's daily figure.

tools.name: commodity_market
tools.description: Iran Mercantile Exchange physical market (بورس کالای ایران: steel, copper, aluminium, zinc, cement, petrochemicals, oil products, bitumen, agricultural goods), straight from ime.co.ir. view='trades' lists a session's offers and contracts: product, producer, hall (تالار), contract type (cash نقدی, forward سلف, credit نسیه; matching مچینگ), delivery date, offered / demand / traded tons, weighted-average closing price with low, high and base price in RIAL PER KILOGRAM, and value in RIAL, with totals by hall and contract type and the top products by value. view='summary' gives IME's roll-ups: value and traded / offered tons per ring, traded value per market (physical, futures, options, financial, certificates), one row per session and IME's dollar rate. Units are in the key names (volume_tons, price_rial_per_kg, value_rial). Without a date the latest session is used; IME trades Saturday to Wednesday, so Thursday and Friday are empty. The trades list leaves out the sub-market and is smaller than the summary: never add them. The exchange-traded boards (gold and saffron certificates, standard forwards, commodity funds, futures) are in top_lists (commodity group) and market_watch (security_type='commodity').
tools.fa: بورس کالا: معاملات و عرضه‌های بازار فیزیکی، آمار تالارها و نرخ دلار

tools.name: energy_market
tools.description: Iran Energy Exchange (بورس انرژی ایران, IRENEX): physical auctions (liquefied gas, solvents, CSO, hexane, liquid nitrogen and other oil, gas and petrochemical products; domestic and international rings) and the electricity market (standard, free and green power contracts), from the exchange's own site (iee.ir). view='trades' gives each auction's result: product, supplier, ring and destination, contract type, offered / demand / traded volume, base and average price and the exchange's value in RIAL; view='offers' the announced auctions; view='auction' one auction's terms, price units, buy and sell order levels and trades; view='overview' whether the market is open and today's traded value. Units differ by product and are spelled out per row: tonne auctions in rial are priced per KILOGRAM, dollar auctions per TONNE, premium auctions as a premium on a reference price, electricity in kW of capacity over the delivery period with kwh the energy and the price per kWh (see price_basis and totals.volume_by_unit; volumes of different units are never added). Without a date the latest session is used; the exchange trades Saturday to Wednesday. The traded boards (electricity forwards and base-load contracts, capacity and energy-saving certificates, energy futures) are in top_lists (energy group).
tools.fa: بورس انرژی: نتیجه عرضه‌ها، برق و فرآورده‌های نفتی، عرضه‌های اعلام‌شده و دفتر سفارش هر عرضه

tools.name: top_lists
tools.description: The exchange's own best-of tables («برترین‌ها» of tsetmc.com): most trades, biggest traded value or volume, price gainers and losers, last price above or below the close, block trades (معاملات عمده), closing-price-only TAL trades, rights (حق تقدم), ETFs, options and futures by volume or open interest, debt papers, energy and commodity markets, the largest buy and sell queues (برترین تقاضا و عرضه), market-value gainers and losers and industries by traded value, for the Bourse, the Fara Bourse and their sub-markets. Rows keep the exchange's own ranking with stable keys (symbol, close, close_pct, last, trades, volume, value ...; rial). Call it first with list_name='catalogue' to see all lists and the flows each one supports.

'catalogue' (default) lists every list with its valid flows, ranking column and fields.

tools.name: capital_calendar
tools.description: Market-wide corporate-action calendar (افزایش سرمایه و تعدیل قیمت), sorted by date: capital increases with the old and new share count, added shares and increase %, and price adjustments (reference-price cuts around dividends and rights) with the adjustment factor, for the days after today, the days up to today, or both. Forward visibility is short: the exchange lists a share-count change only a few days before it takes effect, and price adjustments only after the fact. Not in this feed: dividend per share, ex-dividend and AGM dates, rights exercise price; they are in Codal letters (use codal_filings).

fundamentals.note: eps is the exchange's estimated EPS; pe = last price / eps

order_book.units: price in rial, volume in shares
order_book.note: 5 level(s) are priced outside today's limits (orders for the next session): flagged outside_price_limits.

real_legal.reading: real_buyer_power > 1: the average real-person buyer is larger than the average real-person seller (smart-money accumulation proxy). net_* > 0 on 'real' means money flowed INTO the stock from real persons.

top.name: سازمان توسعه ونوسازی معادن وصنایع معدنی ایران
موسسه صندوق بیمه اجتماعی روستائیان وعشایر

completeness.note: Coverage compares tick data with the exchange's own daily totals; ~100% means nothing is missing.

pressure.method: classic tick rule: a trade above the previous price counts as up, below as down, and a trade at an unchanged price keeps the previous direction
pressure.caveat: TSETMC does not publish who initiated a trade; this is a heuristic, not exchange data.

latest_session.reading: real_buyer_power > 1: the average real-person buyer is larger than the average real-person seller (smart-money accumulation proxy). net_* > 0 on 'real' means money flowed INTO the stock from real persons.

flow.units: value in rial, volume in shares. history rows are published by the exchange; latest_session values are estimated (net volume x VWAP) because the live table has volumes and counts only

tasks.title: One day of ticks: VWAP, biggest trades, bars
Real vs legal money flow, 10 days
One year of daily prices, adjusted
Screen the market: volume > 2x 20-day average, up yesterday and today

traps.what: The exchange's own `priceChange` field in GetClosingPriceInfo
Counting holders / summing percent from the dated shareholder endpoint
Reading real-buyer count with the key used by the live endpoint (`buy_CountI`) on history rows
Calling every limit-up stock without visible sell orders a buy queue, using the gateway's market watch alone
traps.note: Only meaningful when the gateway's top-of-book fields are empty (outside the session).

traps.what: Matching the company name the user types (Persian letters) against the exchange's text (Arabic letters)

bench_agents.model: one LLM agent model, identical in every arm
bench_agents.note: Six tasks, one model, runs per task: 1 (2 for T2 and T6 in the shell and MCP arms). The shell agent used its own knowledge of the exchange's endpoints. On T4 it classified a fixed-price symbol (فولاد3) as an ordinary share, a different but defensible reading of 'ordinary shares'; queue sizes also drift by tens of percent within minutes after the close, so T4 is graded on the ranking only.
